Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to correctly identify the specific historical figure "Anna of Hungary" relevant to the query. The search results contained two distinct individuals with the same name: Anna of Hungary (Byzantine empress, c. 1260–1281, daughter of Stephen V and Elizabeth the Cuman) and Anna of Hungary, Duchess of Macs (c. 1226–1285, daughter of Béla IV and Maria Laskarina). The agent incorrectly associated the mother "Maria Laskarina" with the Byzantine empress (Constantine's mother) instead of the correct mother, "Elizabeth the Cuman." This error stemmed from a failure to disambiguate between the two figures based on their respective time periods and parentage, leading to the identification of the wrong maternal grandmother.
